trust_decision.summary: Whether an unauthenticated network client may invoke MCP tools: decided only by the bind host default (ServerConfig/load_server_config, Helm values) and by main() choosing a transport with no auth gate; the fix adds a refuse-to-start gate in main() for non-loopback HTTP without OAuth, and (bundled) read-only SQL enforcement moved from the read_query tool into PinotClient.execute_query.

landing_point.why: The summary names oauth_enabled=False and the 0.0.0.0 bind; main() is where server_config.host is passed to mcp.run/uvicorn.run and where _auth is (not) built just above (server.py:26-46).

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Module-level FastMCP object `mcp` (built with auth=None when OAuth off) can be served by an external launcher (e.g. fastmcp CLI or an ASGI host importing mcp.http_app()) that never calls main(), so the new bind gate in main() is skipped.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: main()/console script/run.sh are the documented launch paths; running the object through another launcher is the operator's own deployment choice.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: No MCP tool calls them directly at the pinned commit (only execute_query does, pinot_client.py:306,310); they are internal fallbacks of an already-validated call.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other file/package layer from landing point (mcp_pinot/pinot_client.py vs mcp_pinot/server.py)

mcp_pinot_ops is a separate stdio-only server (mcp_pinot_ops/server.py:786) with no read-query tool; its Pinot._execute_query (mcp_pinot_ops/utils/pinot_client.py:48) is not called by any tool.
Docker image (Dockerfile:38, run.sh:11) sets no MCP_HOST, so after the fix the container binds loopback by default; functional, not security, concern.
